name: Errand for Apothecary Zinge

narrative.details:
The kit is ready, adventurer.  No doubt that Apothecary Zinge will want this as soon as possible.  Take it to her without delay, and let her know that I will add the cost of the kit to the Society's tab.  Also, please extend to her my warmest salutations.

Well, don't just stand there.  Such is the life of a simple courier, yes?
narrative.objectives: Bring the Field Sampling Kit to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Good - it pleases me to be working with someone who takes pride in not wasting my time.

After I make some adjustments to this kit, you'll be ready to head out into the field. You'll be using it to collect some vital data to the task at hand.

It will take just a moment for me to finish the modifications. While you are waiting, you should probably start thinking about what you'd like to bring to the desert with you.

Yes, I said the desert.
narrative.requestItemsText:
Yes, I think Luca is as disturbing as you do. It matters not - hand me the field sampling kit. I will need to make some adjustments to it in order to survey for the proper base materials.

You have the kit, don't you?

quests.name: Errand for Apothecary Zinge
quests.objectiveText: Take the purchase order to Alessandro Luca in the Undercity.

quests.name: Errand for Apothecary Zinge
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Field Sampling Kit to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity.

quests.name: Into the Field
quests.objectiveText: Speak to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan about getting a power source for the testing kit.

quests.name: Slake That Thirst
quests.objectiveText: Bring 5 Wastewander Water Pouches to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Tanaris Field Sampling
quests.objectiveText: Acquire acceptable samples for 8 basilisks, 8 hyenas, and 8 scorpions.

quests.name: Another Power Source?
quests.objectiveText: Bring 10 Wastewander Water Pouches to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan in exchange for another power source.

quests.name: Return to Apothecary Zinge
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Sealed Field Testing Kit to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity.
